description:
Two-plus distinct interner arena slots hold MUTUALLY-SUBTYPE (i.e. equal) types.
Interning is supposed to give one identity per type; here one type has many.

## Mechanism PINNED (2026-08-27 probe, release, 00420, arena_len=1426)

The originally-measured pair `{[int],[]} | {[],[int]}`:
- A.tuples = [{Ty114,Ty48},{Ty48,Ty33}]  B.tuples = [{Ty114,Ty48},{Ty48,Ty114}]
- Ty33 = non_empty_list(int), Ty114 = list(int) (both DISPLAY '[int]' -- display
  drops the list empty flag when an element is present, format.rs
  format_list_clause), Ty48 = empty_list().
- One decomposition carved the overlap off ({[], ne[int]}), the other did not
  ({[], pe[int]}); the extra point {[],[]} is covered by the OTHER clause.
  UNION-LEVEL redundancy: neither clause subsumes the other, which is exactly
  why canonicalize_tuple_axis's clause-pairwise absorption misses it.
- The {:cont,_} wrapper pair repeats it one level up with nested tuples that are
  NOT equivalent standalone (Ty1136={[],ne[int]} vs Ty1116={[],pe[int]}).

## Scope is far bigger than the tuple pairs (fz-f98.21 sweep, 2026-08-28)

The faithful canon (landed, compiler2/types/canon.rs) collapses the 00420 arena
much further: one fingerprint group of 849 arrow types renders as 553 distinct
canonical forms -- 296 'one type, two identities' pairs, dominated by arrow
SATURATION: (X) -> any constrains nothing, so it denotes EVERY callable
whatever X is, and the interner mints one id per X. Every memo, dedup, or spec
key hashing on Ty potentially MISSES across all of these. Check whether
SpecKey/activation keying is currently splitting on them.

## Fix direction

The canon normalization pipeline (empty-drop, saturation, union-level
subsumption drop, tuple coordinate widening -- see types/canon.rs) is the
semantics the interner's persistence boundary would need. Whether to run it at
intern (cost on the hot path) or to canonicalize lazily is this ticket's call.

## Checks

- A test asserts no two arena slots are mutually subtype, over the full arena of
  both target fixtures.
- Existing type tests (types_test.rs, incl. union_absorbs_subsumed_tuple_clauses)
  stay green.
- The permanent ratchet is ALREADY LANDED: canon_is_faithful_over_the_full_arena_
  of_both_target_fixtures (compiler2/canon_test.rs) counts collapsed pairs and
  currently asserts > 0, with an inline instruction to flip the expectation to
  zero when this ticket lands.
title: Interner holds two identities for one type: Descr equality is finer than type equivalence
